function: DRL configures the intelligent omni-surface (reflecting and refracting phase shifts and amplitudes) to maximize sensing SNR under user SINR constraints in an ISAC system (p. 4).
system: BS with N=16 antennas, 3 single-antenna users, 1 target; simultaneously reflecting and refracting IOS (STAR-type), M=30 elements; carrier band not stated (pp. 3, 10).
method: Online reinforcement learning: double DQN with echo state network (only output weights trained); transfer learning via staged policy reuse and distillation from pre-trained experts (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Custom Rician channel simulator, first-order Gauss-Markov time correlation (rho=0.8), path loss from [40], Python/NumPy; no dataset or measurements used (pp. 4, 10).
test_conditions: Online learning, no separate test set; sweeps of CSI delay, IOS elements, users, channel correlation; transfer to new target/user positions and NLoS from 30 experts (pp. 11-15).
baselines: Non-learned: MPM (majorization-minimization, penalty, manifold optimization). Learned: MAB (Thompson sampling), DoubleIRS (DRL of [39]); FC [27] and GRU [43] as alternative networks (pp. 11, 14).
metrics: Sensing SNR, number of satisfied users, convergence time slots, simulation run-time per time slot (pp. 11, 14, 15).
complexity: Big-O complexity of forward and backward pass given (p. 10); run-time per slot ESN 1.1 ms, GRU 26.3 ms, FC 10.6 ms (Table IV, p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "The Rician channel model [10] is used for all channels"; path loss only from [40]; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "When a new DeepOSC scheme is deployed, the positions of the target and users as well as the NLoS are reconfigured"; experts pre-trained on other systems, new agent adapts by SPR or SPD transfer.
q3_support: p. 11: "DeepOSC significantly outperforms the MAB and MPM schemes" (MPM is a non-learned optimization); p. 11: "thus attaining a 12.2% higher sensing SNR than DoubleIRS" (DoubleIRS applies the DRL scheme of [39]).
q4_support: p. 10: "the computational complexity of DeepOSC for forward-propagation and back-propagation is calculated" as big-O expressions; Table IV on p. 14 gives run-time per slot.
q5_support: p. 10: "evaluates the performance of DeepOSC based on Python 3.6 simulation platform"; no code link, DOI or public dataset is given and the channels are simulated.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 5 rather than 3: the IOS configuration serves sensing and communication jointly. q2 counts only the SPR/SPD transfer to new target/user positions and NLoS (p. 11, Table V on p. 15); sweeps over CSI delay, elements and users are online learning for each setting and were not counted. Tables II-V were read from the page images.
